book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: Bo giŋsɛ nsa wu Bol bvushi bvu Fɛli le

Aju gɛ̀ bu atɛŋ, Anania wù kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ, bɛ bamii bamu ba sage woŋ, mo Tɛtulu wù gɛ̀ kee nchi chuule bo boh bo gɛɛŋ Kasalia. Bo mo bo gɛɛŋ bo yɛŋ Fɛli muh wù sage le, bo giŋsɛ nsa wuboo wù kune Bol a wu fwe.

Bo tɛɛŋ Bol, Tɛtulu mo wu kɛ wu teede mwɛɛ yi ye ye le, wu jɛmɛ Fɛli le lɛ, “Muh wù baaŋ, kimbonɛ le yi woŋ kfunɛ le too bude yi mɛɛse le, nyu nje je yì joŋe yi wo sage yu, baŋkusɛ ba joŋe le yu wesee woŋ kfunɛ le, chiaaŋ yo le.
Bamii bachii yuge njoŋ baaŋ fede je yì wo sage yu manjuu le manchii, segechii.
Gɛ ŋkoŋe ki njeese kife kuŋ baaŋ gɛ, nlɛge lɛ wo yêgɛ gɛh shige, wo yû fiɛɛ fì bee le be jɛ̂mɛ.
Bee le be yɛŋ lɛ muh wunɛ le muh wu fiɛɛ. Wu jiɛnyi wu shiŋshi ŋgɛ antɛnɛɛ a Bajuu yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le kichii. Ka nyu wu wu le kikwɛɛ ki ŋgoo yi ba tɛŋe lɛ yi Nasalɛ.
Wu gɛ̀ goone tɛ ki wu chɛ̂ŋe bɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ bee koo wu.
Wo bile lo mwɛɛ muh wunɛ le, wo yu a wu le mwɛɛ munɛ munchii mù bee jɛme kune wu.”
No Tɛtulu jɛmɛ noo, Bajuu tooŋ, bo bɛɛsɛ lɛ mwɛɛ munɛ munchii le nchiɛɛŋ.
Bol tanyɛ jwe bvushi bvu Fɛli le
Muh wù sage wɛɛ fe lɛ Bol jɛme. Wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Ŋkee lɛ wo le wo sa wa bansa woŋ kfunɛ le yi biluŋ le wesee. Mɛ mo n'yuge njoŋ ki nlɛ̂ɛŋ ntânyɛ jwe waŋ a wo jii.
Wo nɛ ja lo wo biide, wo yu lɛ aju baaŋ a fe gɛ wa yuufe ncho afaa no nchi mbɛnɛ Yɛlusalɛm ki mbuunɛ Nyo gɛ.
Bajuu gɛ̀ baaŋ yɛŋ gɛ ntɛɛnyi kintɛɛnyɛ besa muh gɛ, bo gɛ̀ baaŋ yɛŋ gɛ tɛ mbɛɛse bamii yeh yi kintanyɛ le kɛnɛ yéh yi buunɛ le, kɛnɛ kijusɛ kimu le a kilaantɛŋ le gɛ.
Gɛ bo kɛme lo fiɛɛ fì duunyi lɛ nle ŋge mwɛɛ munɛ mù bo kooyi yi ye yaŋ le gɛ.
Nle mbɛɛŋ finɛ a wo fwe, lɛ mbuune Nyo wu bachiji besa mbii Je yì bo tɛŋe lɛ le yì befe. Mbɛmɛ nyu mwɛɛ munchii mù le a Ŋwa wu banchi ba Musɛ le bɛ mù le a Baŋwa ba bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo le.
Njiiŋe fwe yi Nyo le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no bamii banɛ tɛ jiiŋe, lɛ bamii bachii ba joŋe bɛ bamii ba befe lé bo gê bo bu yi kwe le.
Noo, mɛ mo ghede chuule segechii nchee kinche ki kooji a Nyo fwe bɛ bamii, fi le lɛ keefɛ fiɛɛ nyû yu fì sâge mɛ fɛ fitele le gɛ.
Le wa biluŋ bì duude le no ŋgɛ ja Yɛlusalɛm, nchi ŋkaasɛ ŋgɛɛŋ yo ki nya bige bamii baŋ ba woŋ le, mo ŋge kintanyɛ.
Le fiɛɛ finɛ fì bo gɛ̀ yɛŋ mɛne yeh yi kintanyɛ le ŋgee, nyu ŋkfuŋ wa kikwɛɛ kaŋ. Gɛ bamii kɛnɛ jwe wu waa gɛ̀ bee fo gɛ.
Bajuu bamu ba Ɛsia gɛ̀ bee fo, bo be kɛme ki bo nyu fɛnɛ ki bo sɛɛŋ wo fiɛɛ fì bo kɛme kune mɛ, fɛnɛ le lɛ fiɛɛ le yu.
Baaŋ noo nyu gɛ, bamii banɛ sɛɛŋ la fiɛɛ fì bo gɛ̀ yɛŋ lɛ nle njiaa sege nchi nlɛme fwe a bamii ba sage woŋ,
fede fiɛɛ fichii fì ŋgɛ̀ njɛmɛ bɛ jɛ yì tɛɛme bo le lɛ, nle a bo fwe yi kife kɛɛ le yi nsa le nje nle mbɛɛŋ lɛ baŋkfusa lé bo gê bo bû yi kwe le.”

Lɛ Bol jɛmɛ noo, Fɛli yegɛ nɛɛ, nyu muh wù kee wa kune Je yi Tada chuule, wu mo wu sheeshɛ nsa wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Sege Lisia wù chiji kikwɛɛ ki bikwɛɛ bi bamii ba nchi lé wu bôh wu tô, fɛ nsuunɛ nsa wunɛ.”
Wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ kikwɛɛ ki ŋgoo yimi yi bamii ba nchi jo Bol yi gɛɛŋ yi leesɛ yeh, bo chîɛɛne. Geenɛ, lɛ bo nyâ gɛh wu bɛ je, bo chînɛ nsáa ye too yi fii wu.
Fɛli sheeshɛ nsa wu Bol yi biluŋ le bifɛɛ
Aju gɛ̀ doo wo kɛŋsɛ, Fɛli bɛ Dusila wù kwɛɛ wù gɛ̀ bee muh wu Bajuu bo to. Fɛli gɛɛŋ wu tɛɛŋ Bol wu to, bo tu bo yege fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme kune ki muh leesɛ fitele yi Kletu Jiso le.

Wu doo wu jɛme kune no taŋlo muh nyume muh wù joŋe, bɛ no taŋlo muh shee bɛ kikwɛɛ ke, bɛ no Nyo lé wu gê wu sâ bamii, Fɛli yu noo, ye kuufɛ wu. Wu mo wu jɛmɛ Bol le lɛ, “Taŋlo wo gɛ̂ɛne mɛɛse, ŋge ndoo ŋkɛme kife fɛ ŋka ntɛ̂ɛŋ wo.”
Wu gɛ̀ jɛme noo, wù kɛme ŋkwajɛ lɛ segemu Bol lé wu kê wu bɛ kwa. Wu tu wu tɛŋe Bol lɛfolɛfo bɛ wu fɛde kinfɛ.
Gɛh noo, gɛh noo, biluŋ kuŋ bifɛɛ. Ba gɛ̀ doo ba gɛɛ Bolsiu Fɛstu yi kinta ki Fɛli le, Fɛli tu wu goone lɛ wu gê Bajuu kôŋe wu, wu mo wu chinɛ Bol le yeh ncha le.

footnotes.text: -7 Baŋwa ba kege bamu kɛme 6b-8a ba saŋ lɛ, “Bee gɛ̀ goone ki be sa bii no nchi wese le, Lisia wu chiji kikwɛɛ ki bikwɛɛ bi bamii ba nchi lee fo, wu lo wu chiaaŋ yese le wu jɛme lɛ bee to be yɛŋ wo le, bee sa nsa we a wo jii.”
